items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I worked at Arnold's for about ten years with Bobrovsky on the violin and Gaspar on the card

ctx.x: No. He plays a lot of tunes that you never know.

But he's got a lot of technique though. Yeah. And he knows a lot of tunes and he knows different Greek tunes and stuff and Hungarian stuff. A lot of times he tries to get me to learn the Hungarian stuff but he's faking them himself. He's not playing them right I know. You know what I mean? He's trying to tell me, he always plays like an exercise. It sounds Hungarian style, you know what I mean? But it's not maybe the authentic thing. You know what I mean? No, no. Now when he plays two guitars, I play with…
Yeah, that's the way it is. A lot of people like that.
